title: Looking for feedback on my 16-bit era side-scrolling beat em up demo/WIP
author: klabelkholosh
selftext:
Hey, always wanted to make a classic arcade side-scroller, so did this browser-based one over the weekend with Claude + [Ludo.ai](http://ludo.ai/) (for sprite gen) and some Gemini here and there for backdrops. Pretty amazed what's possible so quickly! Just trying to see if this is worth continuing.. I've got (what I think) is quite a fun demo level you can try out at:

[https://bloodbathalley.vercel.app/](https://bloodbathalley.vercel.app/)

Still a lot of placeholder art, bad/inconsistent sprite sizing etc. but just wanting to see how it works in diff browsers, or even mobile (there should be on screen joystick!)

Thanks again

comments.author: ASAF12341
comments.body: Why is the enemy bat not going down? It could be a nice mobile game; the graphics and animation, from what I see, are 6/10. However, I need to see more and play it to give an honest review.

replies.author: klabelkholosh
replies.body: Is game in link not showing at good resolution on your pc/mobile? Fair point though thanks.. the graphics are a bit rough, trying to get it all uniform is proving difficult 😓
